title: Reliability-Aware Budget-Gated Diffusion-Map Fusion for Calibrated Potato Disease Image Classification
description: Reproducibility code and locked configuration for a bounded, region-aware correction policy evaluated for calibrated potato disease image classification. The release preserves both the as-executed and equation-consistent BGF implementations and their audit metadata.
